title: Next.js Quick Guide
description: Find a short explanation and a worked example for each idea in the Next.js course.

entries.name: Make the home page
entries.summary: A page.tsx file defines what a route shows.

example.code:
// app/page.tsx export default function Home(){return

Reading club

Pick a story today.

;}

entries.name: Add a second route
entries.summary: A folder with its own page.tsx makes a route.

example.code:
// app/books/page.tsx export default function Books(){return

Books

  • Moon Trip
;}

entries.name: Move between pages with Link
entries.summary: Next.js Link makes navigation between local routes.

entries.name: Share a root layout
entries.summary: A layout wraps pages that belong under it.

entries.name: Add page metadata
entries.summary: Metadata gives a page a browser title and search description.

entries.name: Create a browser counter
entries.summary: A Client Component can use browser state and click handlers.

entries.name: Pass data to a client part
entries.summary: A server page can pass simple serialisable values into a Client Component.

entries.name: Use a local public file
entries.summary: Files in public are served from the site root.

entries.name: Keep component styles local
entries.summary: A CSS module gives a component named classes that are scoped by the build.

entries.name: Generate a small set of book pages
entries.summary: A dynamic route folder uses a value from the address.

entries.name: Show a helpful missing-page message
entries.summary: A not-found file supplies a useful message when the app reaches a missing page.

entries.name: Export static site files
entries.summary: A static export builds files that a static host can serve.
